name: Root / portal member directory — approval frames
description: Contract-freeze UX artifacts for the root/portal member directory. With literal root membership, 'members of root = everyone', so the platform (or a portal's) member view is a paginated, searchable USER DIRECTORY — distinct from the per-org Members & roles surface (authz-admin) which lists a single org's direct members. Subject to gate-pagination: page-based paging and server-side search are contract. Approving the flow approves its visual + interaction model AND commissions a new directory endpoint. frontend-test-engineer drives Playwright against these via the data-frame / data-* hooks.

commissionedByApproval: GET /api/organizations/{id}/directory?query=&page=&pageSize= — a paginated, server-side-searchable list of ALL users of a root/portal org (DirectoryPage { items, page, pageSize, total }). Does NOT exist in packages/security/openapi.yaml today; contract-designer must freeze it.

It is page-based and search-first, deliberately distinct from the cursor-paged GET /v1/security/tenants/{tenantId}/members (small-team member list) — 'everyone' is unbounded so it must never be fetched client-side (gate-pagination).
Directory access is an org-admin/owner (or Employee/ReBAC) capability; a non-privileged caller receives 403 FORBIDDEN.
The same endpoint serves any tenant-root: {id} = the platform root org id OR a portal-root org id ('root' is relative to the portal).

frames.label: (a) Directory
frames.summary: Paginated, searchable directory of all users of a root/portal: person, email, joined date, role pill. Server-side search box, total count, page-based pager (Prev/Next + page-of-pages).
frames.acceptanceNotes: Rows render from GET /api/organizations/{id}/directory (DirectoryPage). data-list='directory'; each row carries data-user. Search is server-side via data-input='directory-search' (query param) — the UI never fetches all users to filter locally. data-count='total' shows the true server total. Pager (data-panel='pagination') is page-based: Prev disabled on page 1. Role pills key to user_role, never hard-coded. Self-row tagged data-self 'You'.

frames.label: (b) States
frames.summary: Loading skeleton (aria-busy), real empty (fresh install = just you), no-search-results (distinct from empty), error+retry, pager boundaries (Prev/Next disabled at the ends), and 403-in-place for a non-admin.
frames.acceptanceNotes: b1 loading = aria-busy row skeletons. b2 empty is REAL (a fresh install has one member). b3 no-results is DISTINCT from empty — the directory has members, the query matched none; offer clear-search (data-action='clear-search'). b4 error shows retry and keeps the search populated. b5 pager boundaries: Prev disabled on page 1, Next disabled on the last page; page count = total/pageSize. b6: a non-privileged caller gets 403 FORBIDDEN rendered in place with zero data — NEVER a sign-in redirect (only 401 re-authenticates).
